solution:
The correct answer is __Sugar mill.__

• __Tertiary sector

 
 
• ​Numerous small businesses that provide services to the primary and secondary sectors of the economy make up the tertiary sector of the economy, commonly known as the service sector.
 
• Schools, financial institutions, insurance businesses, banking institutions, restaurants, hotels, and many more are all considered to be part of the tertiary sector.
